description: Puntos WIFI is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. List of municipal WIFI points in the city of Zaragoza. It describes the status, services and radius of each point. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. The portal shows the English title as "WIFI Points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. Its keywords include internet, wifi, conexión, redes inalámbricas, telecomunicaciones. The listing shows 1 download or service links in API. The listing shows 2015-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.zaragoza.es/sede/portal/aviso-legal#condiciones). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
